newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers OTC yeast treatment available.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers OTC yeast treatment available.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Monday that VAGISTAT-1 ointment over-the-counter (OTC) medication for vaginal yeast infections is now available in drug and food stores as well as mass merchandise outlets nationwide.
Bristol-Myers said that this is the the first and only one-dose OTC medication for vaginal yeast infections.
The company received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market VAGISTAT-1 as an over-the-counter treatment for vaginal yeast infections in February 1997.
